messages:
Maya R: FYI — HelixHealth returned the vendor questionnaire and asked for non-prod DB snapshots, production console screenshots, and an SSO flow video. They also pushed for SOC2 evidence (control IDs) ahead of renewal. Anyone seen this combo? Not comfortable sharing prod screenshots.
Sam C: Do not share production screenshots or DB snapshots. Ask for an NDA/DPA addendum first. We can provide redacted logs, a sanitized non-prod export, and a read-only demo tenant.
Jonah T: +1. Security constraints:
- Never share raw prod data.
- Offer sanitized export + steps to reproduce.
- Provide SOC2 Type II cert + control mapping doc.
Checklist suggestion: 1) confirm exact artifacts they want; 2) NDAs + DPA addendum; 3) sanitize non-prod export; 4) staged SSO demo (recording); 5) legal sign-off if anything prod-adjacent.
Liz P: I can record a 2-min staging SSO walkthrough if we spin up a staging user and temporary tenant. Do we have 48h? Helix asked "within 48h" in their email.
Maya R: Yes, timeline is tight — they requested 48h. @Ava L (Legal) can you draft an NDA addendum? @Jonah T can you confirm what evidence packet we should send first?
Jonah T: Looping legal. Draft evidence packet = "Evidence Packet A" (SOC2 cert, control mapping, policy docs, incident response summary). Link to template: https://redwood.internal/legal/controls-mapping-template
Ava L (Legal): Received. I'll push an NDA addendum draft within ~2 hours. Important: if they explicitly request prod screenshots or direct DB access we need exec approval and vendor-risk gating. We'll request scope-narrowing to staging only.
onboard-bot: Reminder: run artifact-scan before sharing any files: `./scripts/artifact-scan --redact --level=high` :white_check_mark:
Liz P: Draft email to Helix below, thoughts? (paste)
```
Hi Claire / Helix team,

Thanks for the questionnaire — we can provide a scoped evidence packet and a short staging SSO walkthrough, but we cannot share production screenshots or raw DB snapshots. Next steps we propose:

1) Sign our NDA addendum / DPA appendix (attached)
2) We will provide Evidence Packet A (SOC2 Type II cert, control mapping PDF, IR summary)
3) We will deliver a sanitized non-prod export and a 2-minute staging SSO demo video
4) If you need additional artifacts, please specify exact control IDs and business justification; anything production-facing requires exec approval.

We aim to deliver the initial packet within 48 hours of NDA execution. Please confirm and we9ll kick off.

Best,
Maya on behalf of Redwood CS
```
Maya R: That looks good. Sam, can you prepare the sanitized export? Liz, please schedule the recording. Ava will handle the NDA. I'll send the email and CC legal.
Sam C: Starting the sanitized export now. ETA ~6 hours for scan + redact. Will post checksum and sanitized manifest when done.
Jonah T: Security review scheduled in 1 hour. I'll flag as high priority for renewal risk and ensure artifact-scan completes.
Ava L (Legal): NDA draft uploaded to Legal Drive: https://redwood.internal/legal/drafts/helix-nda-addendum.docx — will update after security feedback.
Maya R: Setting a quick sync in 30 mins to confirm statuses. Creating checklist in Notion and linking here: https://notion.so/redwood/helix-evidence-queue
Sam C: Copy. Posting progress updates in thread.
Maya R: Closing loop for now — thanks everyone :pray:
